name: Rikuno
source:
One of the mysterious twins in the mansion that has the exact same movement, speaks at the exact same time with same words, and does everything together. Not very talkative and hangs out in the library most of the time, they are like the dolls of the mansion. Her hobby seems to be divination, and can be seen fortune-telling with tarot cards at times.

[Edited and taken from [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/12/04/midori-no-umi-review/]Warum's review[/url].]
